segments.name: Intelligent Content Management
segments.description: Provides a single cloud-based SaaS platform that lets organizations securely manage, share, sign, classify and retain their unstructured business content.
segments.evidence: Box is the leading Intelligent Content Management (ICM) provider.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees based on user counts, API and AI unit entitlements and functionality deployed, invoiced at the start of contract terms of one to three years or more.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer our solution to customers as a subscription-based service, with subscription fees based on customer requirements, including the number of users, API and AI unit entitlements, and functionality deployed.
